request.prompt: Animate this 3D anime Korean teacher revealing the answer in a classroom. COMPOSITION: The teacher stands IN FRONT OF the chalkboard in the RIGHT THIRD OF THE FRAME, with her body centered around 72-78% of the image width. Leave the LEFT TWO-THIRDS open as a clean green chalkboard. The teacher must NOT be centered. Medium shot, waist-up. MOTION: The teacher first turns slightly toward the board and traces a short deliberate answer-reveal motion in the air as if writing with chalk, then opens her left palm toward the chalkboard and gives a confident satisfied nod. The gesture should feel like presenting the answer, not like repeating the same pose from other scenes. Keep the movement smooth and instructional. LIGHTING: Keep the same neutral warm classroom lighting as the question scene with no sudden yellow flare, no dramatic brightness boost, and no color temperature jump. FORMAT: Horizontal 16:9. IMPORTANT: Do NOT generate any text, chalk marks, subtitles, logos, watermarks, or overlays.
